domain_context: Logistics Transportation Management System (TMS) & Order-to-Cash, B2B Enterprise Dashboard

layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen bg-slate-900 text-slate-50 border-r border-slate-800
layout_and_spacing.cards: rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm p-4
layout_and_spacing.tables: w-full text-sm text-left. Header: bg-slate-50 border-y border-slate-200 uppercase text-xs font-bold text-slate-500. Cells: border-b border-slate-100 py-2 px-3 align-top

components.buttons: rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-1
components.inputs: rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 bg-white

visual_enhancers.shadows: Keep shadows minimal. Rely on 1px borders for structure.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid slate-200 for containers, cards, and tables.

image_urls.description: Use as a full-bleed background for the login page with a dark overlay (e.g., bg-slate-900/70) to ensure the login form remains highly legible.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use .js (JavaScript) exclusively for React components, NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Ensure all copy and UI text is in Bahasa Indonesia (e.g., 'Total Pendapatan', 'Faktur Pajak', 'Rekap Bulanan').
Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): 'Operation' role vs 'Finance' role views.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to ALL interactive and key elements using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='awb-status-badge').
Use Shadcn UI components adapted for JavaScript. Opt for dense sizing (e.g., reduce default padding to p-2 or p-3 on table cells).
For the Monthly Recap & Export feature, use SheetJS (xlsx) to handle Excel exports.
For the Invoice Print Dashboard, build a web-based layout optimized for browser printing (window.print()) using @media print CSS rules.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Setup 'Chivo' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body in tailwind.config.js.
Maintain the high-contrast, Swiss Brutalist design language: color is purely functional, UI is 95% monochrome (slate scales), with bright colors reserved exclusively for statuses and primary actions.
For forms, implement dynamic cost calculation (total_tariff/tax_amount/grand_total).
Use a robust sidebar layout matching the dense control room style.
